import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
cameras = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a bar chart to compare the number of cameras from different brands
brand_counts = cameras['brand'].value_counts()

plt.ylabel('Count')

plt.tight_layout()

plt.title('Megapixels vs Price')
plt.xlabel('Megapixels')
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, overwrite=True)

plt.xlabel('Price (USD)')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, overwrite=True)

sns.scatterplot(x='megapixels', y='price_usd', data=cameras)
